A GitHub APK is installed outside Google Play, so Android may ask you to allow this install source and Play Protect may show a warning.

This warning comes from Android because the APK is sideloaded and is not installed from Google Play. The app cannot disable or bypass this security screen. A Play Store distribution would avoid the unknown-source install prompt, but SMS permissions are subject to Google Play policy.
The app requests RECEIVE_SMS so it can detect new matching messages. SEND_SMS is requested only when SMS forwarding is enabled.

Samsung: Settings → Apps → SMS Auto Forwarder → Battery → Unrestricted. Also review Background usage limits if forwarding stops.
Xiaomi / Redmi / POCO: enable Background autostart for this app and set Battery saver to No restrictions.
Allow this app to run in the background and disable aggressive battery optimization if your phone stops it.
Dual-SIM: forwarding uses Android\'s default SMS SIM. Set the default SMS SIM in system settings if needed.
Do not forward OTP, banking codes, or confidential messages unless the recipient is explicitly authorized and trusted.
